mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important element of the school curriculum and a teacher's awareness of this is vital for effective usage of the curriculum."
The National Curriculum is an important element of the school curriculum and a teacher's awareness of this is vital for effective usage of the curriculum.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a style of the presentation of content in classroom."
Methods Method is a style of the presentation of content in classroom.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an approach designed to help teachers find out what students are learning in the classroom and how well they are learning it."
Classroom assessment is an approach designed to help teachers find out what students are learning in the classroom and how well they are learning it.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the opposite of the exposition method, as it requires students to recognise principles independently."
Guided discovery is the opposite of the exposition method, as it requires students to recognise principles independently.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a complex process that attempts to make abstract concepts tangible, difficult ideas understandable and multifaceted problems solvable."
Mathematics instruction is a complex process that attempts to make abstract concepts tangible, difficult ideas understandable and multifaceted problems solvable.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the primary prerequisite to the pursuit of knowledge in any field."
The desire to learn is the primary prerequisite to the pursuit of knowledge in any field.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the resources that a teacher may integrate in a method for the transaction of a particular content and draw upon to advance the students' learning."
Pedagogic Resources Pedagogic resources are the resources that a teacher may integrate in a method for the transaction of a particular content and draw upon to advance the students' learning.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the second of four stages of cognitive development."
Preoperational stage The preoperative stage is the second of four stages of cognitive development.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to the conditions or the appearances in which things or persons can be found between transformations."
States refer to the conditions or the appearances in which things or persons can be found between transformations.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the rule that refers to grouping."
The Associative Property is the rule that refers to grouping.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to a variety of self-regulation strategies that students can use to manage themselves as learners and direct their own behavior, including their attention (Graham, Harris, & Reid, 1992)."

Self-instruction refers to a variety of self-regulation strategies that students can use to manage themselves as learners and direct their own behavior, including their attention (Graham, Harris, & Reid, 1992).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of establishing a sequential connection of a set of stimulus- response pairs for the purpose of attaining a particular goal."
Chaining is the process of establishing a sequential connection of a set of stimulus- response pairs for the purpose of attaining a particular goal.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most effective learning tool at this stage because it directly does what is required."
Rote learning is the most effective learning tool at this stage because it directly does what is required.
